SECURITY

Help us keep
the road trusted.

Security reports for My Road — My Glory merchandise and the VYNDI Terrain Medal Studio are handled privately by the Vāyú Shastr team.

Report a vulnerability

Email info@vayushastr.com with the affected URL, clear reproduction steps, impact and any supporting evidence.

Scope

The public merchandise experience, Terrain Medal Studio and their same-origin APIs are in scope. Do not perform denial-of-service testing, destructive testing, credential attacks, social engineering or attacks against unrelated third-party services.

Responsible disclosure

Please give us reasonable time to investigate and remediate before public disclosure. Do not access, modify or retain data that is not your own.

Authenticity

The canonical public service is hosted at vmm.vayushastr.workers.dev. Official correspondence uses @vayushastr.com.
